name: Readwise
tagline: Search your highlights and Reader library, and save what you read.
summary: Search and read the user's Readwise highlights and Reader documents, save new documents and highlights, and tag and file them. Highlights are changed or deleted only after the user approves.
can: Search your highlights, notes and saved documents
Save articles to Reader, and add highlights, notes and tags
Change or delete a highlight, or change many documents at once, only after you approve it
